identity.name: Mobile Workflow — Working with Mandala from Android
identity.description: Complete guide for working with Mandala Symbiosis from Android phone using Termux. All update commands are single-block copy-paste ready — they include git add, commit, and push.

golden_rule.title: ONE COPY — ONE ACTION — FULL DEPLOY
golden_rule.description: Every code block marked as 'FULL DEPLOY' is a COMPLETE command. It creates/updates the file, adds to git, commits, and pushes to GitHub. Copy ONCE, paste ONCE, press ENTER. The entire change is live. No separate git add/commit/push steps.
golden_rule.example: When you see a block starting with 'cat > ... << EOF' and ending with 'git push', that's the whole thing. Copy from 'cat' to 'git push' inclusive.

setup.description: One-time setup. Do this only once.

steps.name: FULL DEPLOY after editing
steps.description: After you finish editing in micro, use a FULL DEPLOY block provided by External SR. It will add, commit, and push automatically.

full_deploy_pattern.description: External SR will provide updates in this format. Copy the WHOLE block.
full_deploy_pattern.template:
cat > honeycombs/path/to/file.json << 'EOF'
{ ... full JSON content ... }
EOF
git add honeycombs/path/to/file.json
git commit -m "feat: description"
git push
full_deploy_pattern.note: This single block replaces the file, adds to git, commits, and pushes. No extra steps.

micro_shortcuts.note: Use Volume Up as Ctrl on Android.
